onboarding.portal_subtitle: Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation • Government of India

step1.title: Learning Preferences
step1.subtitle: Personalize your KaushalAI experience. Configure your preferred language, color theme, and appearance mode before proceeding.
step1.settings_notice: You can modify these preferences anytime later in Settings.
step1.language_sub: Select the language for portal navigation and learning material
step1.theme_sub: Select your portal color palette for buttons, navigation, and accents
step1.appearance_sub: Switch between standard high-clarity Light mode and comfortable Dark mode
step1.dark_mode_desc: Reduced glare for comfortable prolonged reading

step2.heading: What areas of work interest you?
step2.description: Select the professional domains you are interested in. Your selections will help us personalize your learning experience.
step2.min_requirement_notice: Select at least 1 domain to continue
step2.ready_notice: Ready to proceed. You can select additional domains if desired.

survey_operations.name: Data Collection & Survey Operations
survey_operations.desc: National sampling frames, household & enterprise field surveys, CAPI digital instruments, and multi-stage sampling.

statistical_analysis.name: Statistical Analysis & Modeling
statistical_analysis.desc: Descriptive and inferential statistics, sampling error estimation, hypothesis testing, and regression analysis for official data.

data_processing.name: Data Processing & Management
data_processing.desc: Enterprise database structures, SQL query pipelines, administrative big data registers, and scalable ETL processing.

data_quality.name: Data Quality & Validation
data_quality.desc: Multi-stage field data scrutiny, high-frequency validation checks, statistical auditing, and data quality frameworks.

data_visualization.name: Data Visualization & Reporting
data_visualization.desc: Interactive analytical dashboards, thematic statistical charting, GIS spatial mapping, and publication infographics.

research_methodology.name: Research & Methodology
research_methodology.desc: Questionnaire formulation, stratification strategies, small area estimation, and survey design research methodologies.

national_accounts.name: National Accounts & Macroeconomics
national_accounts.desc: Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Gross Value Added (GVA), supply-use tables, capital formation, and institutional sector accounts.

price_indices.name: Price Indices & Economic Indicators
price_indices.desc: Consumer Price Index (CPI), Index of Industrial Production (IIP), wholesale price deflators, and inflation tracking.

official_policy.name: Official Statistics & Policy
official_policy.desc: Government statistical governance, public data policies, confidentiality protocols, and evidence-based decision making.

digital_tools.name: Digital Tools & Technology
digital_tools.desc: Statistical computing in Python and R, machine learning algorithms, automated data scrutiny, and cybersecurity governance.

data_dissemination.name: Data Dissemination & SDG Tracking
data_dissemination.desc: Public data release portals, microdata anonymization, National Indicator Framework (NIF), and UN SDG monitoring.

administration_coordination.name: Administration & Coordination
administration_coordination.desc: Field office coordination, project management, resource allocation, and inter-divisional statistical workflows.

step4.heading: Which skills would you like to develop?
step4.description: Choose the competencies you want to strengthen. We will use your interests to personalize your learning journey and combine them with your assessment results.

step5.heading: Diagnostic Competency Assessment
step5.subtitle: Take an objective 15-question scenario assessment calibrated to your Cadre Level ({{level}}) to establish your baseline proficiency.
step5.guidelines_desc: Questions reflect real administrative and statistical scenarios encountered in the Ministry. Your responses are graded deterministically server-side.
step5.timer_expired_msg: The 20-minute assessment window has expired. Answers can no longer be modified.
step5.confirm_desc: Once submitted, your answers will be deterministically graded server-side and your baseline competency levels will be established. This action cannot be undone.
step5.confirm_unanswered_warning: Notice: You have {{count}} unanswered question(s). Unanswered questions will receive 0 marks.
step5.already_completed_notice: ✓ You have completed this diagnostic assessment (Score: {{score}}%). Proceed to Step 6 to review results and graduate to your dashboard.

step6.heading: Your Competency Assessment Results
step6.subtitle: Your diagnostic assessment is complete. Review your competency levels, identify development opportunities, and explore the learning recommendations prepared for your professional role.
step6.performance_desc: Measured proficiency levels across core competencies tested in your diagnostic assessment against official cadre role benchmarks.
step6.strengths_desc: Competencies where you demonstrated strong proficiency or met/exceeded your role requirements.
step6.no_strengths: No specific strengths identified yet. Focusing on your priority skill gaps will help build balanced proficiency.
step6.gaps_desc: Targeted development areas where your assessed level is below the required benchmark for your cadre role.
step6.no_gaps: Congratulations! You have satisfied all benchmark competency requirements for your cadre role.
step6.recommendations_desc: Curated courses from iGOT Karmayogi and KaushalAI specifically selected to close your identified competency gaps.
step6.no_recommendations: No specific course recommendations found at this time. You can explore the full course catalog from your dashboard.
step6.learning_path_desc: A sequenced development roadmap structured for your role and cadre level progression.
step6.no_learning_path: Learning path is being sequenced for your cadre role.
step6.graduation_desc: Click below to complete your onboarding setup. Your personalized learner dashboard, progress tracking, and AI tutoring will be activated immediately.
step6.no_assessment_desc: You need to complete the diagnostic assessment in Step 5 before viewing your results and graduating.
